hook: Your Moon can hide the whole Sun.
title: Your Moon Hides the Entire Sun
description:
The Sun is about 400 times wider than the Moon, and also about 400 times farther away. That is why the Moon can cover the Sun almost exactly in a total solar eclipse. Series: Space Coincidences.

#Shorts #SolarEclipse #Space
comment_prompt: Seen a total eclipse? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your Moon can hide the whole Sun.
scenes.headline: MOON HIDES THE SUN

scenes.narration: The Sun is far bigger than the Moon.
scenes.headline: SUN IS HUGE

scenes.narration: But it's also about 400 times farther away.
scenes.headline: 400× FARTHER

scenes.narration: So both look the same size in your sky.
scenes.headline: SAME SIZE IN SKY

scenes.narration: That perfect match is pure coincidence.
scenes.headline: PURE COINCIDENCE

scenes.narration: The Moon drifts away, so this won't last forever.
scenes.headline: IT WON'T LAST

scenes.narration: Right now, your Moon hides the whole Sun.
scenes.headline: RIGHT NOW, IT FITS
